display_long_description:
# Welcome to Hustle Rock, the city of crime!
Shiesty is a free-to-play open-world crime sandbox in VR where there are no rules. Steal cars, rob stores, and climb the criminal underworld with your friends. Just watch out for the cops!

**Key Features**:
- 💰 **Rob Anything & Anyone**: Hold up stores, lockpick registers, and point your weapon at any NPC to make them cough up the goods.
- 🚗 **Steal & Customize**: Collect every car and gun in Hustle Rock, then customize them your way.
- 🚨 **Wanted Stars**: The more chaos you cause, the harder the police come after you.
- 👑 **Rise Through the Ranks**: Fence your loot at the pawn shop, then pay the Don what you owe to level up.
- 📱 **Play with Friends**: Call any player directly on your in-game phone, complete with a mini map.
- 🪝 **Move Your Way**: Climb, drive, zip line, and grapple your way across the city.

**Free to play November 5th, 2026, only on Meta Quest. Ready to get Shiesty?**
